title: 感受野递推：堆叠卷积与 stride 的影响
expected_output:
4 层 3x3 stride1 堆叠 -> 感受野: 9 (= 1+2+2+2=7)
3 层 3x3 stride2 -> 感受野: 15
1 个 7x7 stride1 -> 感受野: 7
对比: 3x3x3 (7) vs 7x7 (7) 感受野相同, 但 3x3x3 参数量 27C^2 < 49C^2
混合 (3,1)(3,2)(3,1) -> 感受野: 9
code:
import numpy as np
def rf_of_layers(layers):
    rf=1; jump=1
    for k,s in layers:
        rf = rf + (k-1)*jump
        jump = jump*s
    return rf, jump
stack_3x3 = [(3,1),(3,1),(3,1),(3,1)]
print("4 层 3x3 stride1 堆叠 -> 感受野:", rf_of_layers(stack_3x3)[0], "(= 1+2+2+2=7)")
stack_stride = [(3,2),(3,2),(3,2)]
rf2,_ = rf_of_layers(stack_stride)
print("3 层 3x3 stride2 -> 感受野:", rf2)
# 7x7 单层
print("1 个 7x7 stride1 -> 感受野:", rf_of_layers([(7,1)])[0])
print("对比: 3x3x3 (7) vs 7x7 (7) 感受野相同, 但 3x3x3 参数量 27C^2 < 49C^2")
# 有 stride 的小核 vs 大核
mixed = [(3,1),(3,2),(3,1)]
print("混合 (3,1)(3,2)(3,1) -> 感受野:", rf_of_layers(mixed)[0])
